notices.short_title: Notice of Adoption of Chapter 6 of Title 31 of the Rules of the City of New York
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services adopted a rule, published in The City Record on Jan. 13, 2026, that amends Chapter 6 of Title 31 of the Rules of the City of New York.

notices.short_title: DSNY Proposed Amendment of Rules Relating to the Implementation of the Eighth and Ninth Commercial Waste Zones and Infrequent Waste Generators
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation will hold a public hearing on Feb. 18, 2026, on proposed rule changes for implementing the Eighth and Ninth Commercial Waste Zones and rules for infrequent waste generators.

notices.short_title: Rescue Stretcher System, SKED, Deployment Case and Firefighter Rescue Stretcher
notices.plain: The Fire Department has scheduled a public comment session on its proposed rescue stretcher system contract, which covers the SKED stretcher, deployment case and firefighter rescue stretcher.

notices.short_title: Maintenance and Repair of Randalls Island Grade Crossing
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has scheduled a public comment period on its proposed maintenance and repair contract for the Randalls Island grade crossing, as listed in a notice published Jan. 13, 2026.

notices.short_title: Integrated Facility Upgrade Project Contract
notices.plain: The Department of Probation is holding a public comment period on its Integrated Facility Upgrade Project contract, which the notice describes only by title.

notices.short_title: Convert SAS Code to Oracle PL SQL
notices.plain: The Administration for Children's Services awarded Mola Group Corp a $98,910 contract to convert SAS code to Oracle PL SQL, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: SIMULTANEOUS INTERPRETATION SERVICES, RENEWAL #2
notices.plain: The city comptroller's office awarded Accurate Communication Inc. a $15,461.25 renewal, its second, for simultaneous interpretation services, using a small-purchase process reserved for certified minority- or women-owned businesses that skips open competition.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: IT Consulting Critical Infrastructure Support Initiative
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Currier McCabe & Associates Inc a $600,000 contract for IT consulting and critical infrastructure support, purchased through a contract another government already holds.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: DSS Classroom and Teleconferencing Rooms Hardware and Equipment
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Winglee LLC a $45,250 contract for classroom and teleconferencing room hardware and equipment, through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

notices.short_title: Bid Extension: Request for Bids for Transportation of Goods and Equipment
notices.plain: The Department of Education is seeking bids for transportation of goods and equipment, with the lowest qualified bid to win, and responses are due Feb. 27, 2037.

notices.short_title: COOP Application Software
notices.plain: New York City Emergency Management awarded SLAM Technical Services LLC a $634,226 contract for COOP application software, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.short_title: BIT Lookout License Support & Maintenance 6300041X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded American Computer Consultants Inc a $670,320 contract for support and maintenance of Lookout licenses, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Long Spine Immobilization Boards and Bags
notices.plain: The Fire Department awarded Portland Williams LLC a $70,638 contract for long spine immobilization boards and bags, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: EXPERIS US - CITYWIDE SI CLASS 3 RENEWAL
notices.plain: The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications renewed its citywide contract with Experis US LLC for up to $50 million in IT services.

notices.short_title: Photography and Videography for Events
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services awarded 1030 Production Services LLC a $150,000 contract for photography and videography for events, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: Public Hearing for BSA Application No. 2025-40-BZ.
notices.plain: The Community Boards agency is holding a public hearing on Jan. 15, 2026, about Board of Standards and Appeals Application No. 2025-40-BZ.

notices.short_title: Claremont House
notices.plain: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development will hold a public hearing on the Claremont House on Feb. 11, 2026.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: 2026-2027 Biennial Temporary Assistance and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program Employment Plan for the City of New York
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration published notice of its 2026-2027 biennial employment plan for the City of New York, covering its Temporary Assistance and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program work requirements.

notices.short_title: LL63/DOT/NEW
notices.plain: The Mayor's Office of Contract Services published a notice on Jan. 13, 2026, under the title "LL63/DOT/NEW," which does not describe a specific action in plain terms.
